title: VINDHYATEL — Trade Brief · 03 Jun 2026
catalyst: An AI/data-centre-led optical-fibre upcycle is re-rating India's OFC complex, and Vindhya — simultaneously carving out its fibre-infra unit at ~₹1,830 Cr EV and absorbing Birla Cable — is the deep-discount proxy trading below the ₹3,098 Cr market value of its listed investments.
